'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 Casey Anis LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casey Anis]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
